whatsapp.disabled_because: Operator does not use WhatsApp any more. The inbound bridge last processed a message 2026-06-22; outbound was still pushing review notifications on every notifier run, and that docker exec into the openclaw gateway is what blocked for 8 hours against an unresponsive Docker daemon on 2026-11-17, taking the whole sidecar (including the operator inbox poller) down with it. Turning this off removes the hang's only remaining entry point. The launchd job com.philtullai.duckops.whatsapp-bridge is still loaded and still dead; unloading it is a separate Tier-3 action.
